result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.network_robustness()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page doc-py-api-page shift-heading-level-by: 0 toc-depth: 3 page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Simulate progressive node removal and measure network degradation. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L16019-L16086){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.network_robustness( strategy="degree", steps=None, seed=None, return_dict=False, ) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Removes nodes one at a time according to a strategy and records the fraction of nodes in the largest connected component at each step. Useful for studying essential genes and network vulnerability in protein–protein interaction networks. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [strategy]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [["degree"]{.st}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Node removal strategy: - `"degree"`: remove highest-degree nodes first (targeted attack). - `"betweenness"`: remove highest-betweenness nodes first. - `"random"`: remove nodes in random order. [steps]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [int | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Number of nodes to remove. Defaults to all nodes. [seed]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [int | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Random seed (only used when `strategy="random"`). [return_dict]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [bool]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[False]{.va}]{.doc-parameter-default} : If `True`, return the robustness curve as a list of `(fraction_removed, largest_component_fraction)` tuples. If `False`, store the result and return `self` for chaining. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [Graph | list[tuple[float, float]]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : The robustness curve (if `return_dict=True`) or `self`. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} ::: {#28409940 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec g = ec.Graph() for i in range(10): g.add_node(label=str(i)) for i in range(9): g.add_edge(source=str(i), target=str(i + 1)) curve = g.network_robustness(strategy="degree", return_dict=True) curve[:3] ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` [(0.0, 1.0), (0.1, 0.8), (0.2, 0.7)] ``` ::: :::
